method.model_mean: arithmetic mean across the four architecture predictions
method.model_sigma: sample standard deviation across four architectures (ddof=1)
method.joint_error: RMS of consensus-minus-FEMM errors standardized by V3 training target std
method.joint_disagreement: RMS of architecture sample sigmas standardized by V3 training target std
method.high_error_selection: largest 500 joint standardized consensus errors on full_test
method.random_selection: uniform without replacement from remaining full_test samples; seed=20260827

interpretation_notes: The 500 high-error rows are deliberately outcome-selected using FEMM truth; do not use the combined 1,000 rows to estimate population prevalence or an unbiased correlation.
Use population_summary for unbiased association/enrichment evidence across all 14,655 frozen test genes.
A useful FEMM acquisition channel should show increasing true error as disagreement rises and should enrich high-error cases in top-disagreement subsets.
Architecture predictions are two-seed means; sigma measures disagreement among four architecture ensembles, not seed uncertainty within one architecture.
